title: Reel 2 opening; Kerry Fritz at the Entertainers Cabaret
summary: Date noted, selling bricks to women, and the entertainer Kerry Fritz and his theme song and repertoire.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: This is Lemonash Real 2. What's the date? What is it, Lemon? What is the date?
The date of the month? It's the 20th. It's the 20th, the date of 1961.
You were talking about how you sold the women what? 1961.
I used to sell the women's brick to scrub the box steps with.
Did I do this all up?
This fellow, Kerry Fritz, he was one of the star entertainers at the Entertainers Cabaret down on Appleville and Franklin at that time.
Well, he stood up. Folks came from miles around to hear him sing, I'll Goodbye as Long as I Have You. That was his theme song.

And he sung all those songs up in New Orleans. Numbers like, Ain't Anybody Seen My Kitty, Listen to the Mocking Birds, and numbers like How Many Times Have I Said I Love You, numbers like Me and My Shadow, Bye Bye Black Bird, Someday Sweetheart.
